en.tagline: A zero-framework multi-agent orchestration engine built from scratch.
en.problemBody: Existing agent frameworks often lock engineers into rigid abstractions, opaque retry loops, and unpredictable memory states—making debugging and security governance nearly impossible at scale.
en.pipelineHint: Tap or hover any node to inspect deterministic guarantees

features.title: Probabilistic Turn Loops & Mixture-of-Agents
features.desc: Native execution loop supporting three distinct MoA collaboration modes without hidden middleware overhead or opaque retry chains.

features.title: Markdown Graph Memory
features.desc: Human-readable, inspectable graph-based memory architecture—eliminating black-box vector state drift and enabling Git-diffable state audits.

features.title: Chain-of-Verification (CoV) Guardians
features.desc: Built-in verification layers to cross-examine intermediate reasoning, catch hallucinations, and enforce output integrity before downstream execution.

features.title: Protocol & Provider Agnostic
features.desc: Native MCP (Model Context Protocol) bridging paired with multi-provider BYOK routing so engineering teams never face vendor lock-in.

id.tagline: Mesin orkestrasi multi-agent tanpa framework yang dibangun dari nol.
id.problemBody: Framework agent yang ada sering mengunci engineer pada abstraksi kaku, loop retry yang buram, dan state memori yang tidak terprediksi—membuat debugging serta tata kelola keamanan sangat sulit pada skala produksi.
id.pipelineHint: Sentuh atau arahkan kursor ke tiap node untuk melihat jaminan deterministiknya

features.title: Probabilistic Turn Loops & Mixture-of-Agents
features.desc: Loop eksekusi native yang mendukung tiga mode kolaborasi MoA berbeda tanpa overhead middleware tersembunyi.

features.title: Markdown Graph Memory
features.desc: Arsitektur memori berbasis graph yang mudah dibaca dan diaudit manusia—menghilangkan drift state vector kotak hitam.

features.title: Chain-of-Verification (CoV) Guardians
features.desc: Lapisan verifikasi bawaan untuk menguji silang penalaran, menangkap halusinasi, dan menjaga integritas output sebelum eksekusi lanjutan.

features.title: Agnostik Protokol & Provider
features.desc: Bridging MCP (Model Context Protocol) secara native yang dipadukan dengan routing BYOK multi-provider tanpa vendor lock-in.

en.title: STAGE 01 // USER INPUT & BOUNDARY INGESTION
en.desc: Validates incoming payloads, enforces strict schema budgets, and isolates untrusted prompt context before entering the execution runtime.

id.title: TAHAP 01 // INGESTI INPUT & BATAS KEAMANAN
id.desc: Memvalidasi payload masuk, menegakkan batas skema dan token secara ketat, serta mengisolasi konteks prompt tak tepercaya sebelum masuk ke runtime.

en.title: STAGE 02 // MULTI-PROVIDER BYOK ROUTER
en.desc: Routes tasks across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or local inference endpoints using capability tiers and fallback policies without external SDK bloat.

id.title: TAHAP 02 // ROUTER BYOK MULTI-PROVIDER
id.desc: Mengarahkan tugas ke endpoint OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, atau model lokal berdasarkan profil kapabilitas dan kebijakan fallback tanpa SDK berat.

en.title: STAGE 03 // PROBABILISTIC TURN LOOP & MoA ENGINE
en.desc: Native Python turn loop orchestrating Mixture-of-Agents collaboration (sequential, parallel synthesis, or adversarial critique) with transparent state.

id.title: TAHAP 03 // TURN LOOP PROBABILISTIK & MESIN MoA
id.desc: Turn loop Python native yang mengorkestrasi kolaborasi Mixture-of-Agents (sekuensial, sintesis paralel, atau kritik adversarial) dengan state transparan.

en.title: STAGE 04 // CHAIN-OF-VERIFICATION (CoV) GUARDIAN
en.desc: Cross-examines claims, tool invocations, and schema invariants independently before any output is persisted or executed downstream.

id.title: TAHAP 04 // PENJAGA CHAIN-OF-VERIFICATION (CoV)
id.desc: Menguji silang klaim, pemanggilan tool, dan invarian skema secara independen sebelum output disimpan atau dieksekusi ke sistem hilir.

en.title: STAGE 05 // MARKDOWN GRAPH MEMORY COMMIT
en.desc: Persists relational agent knowledge into human-readable, Git-diffable Markdown graph nodes—eliminating opaque vector drift.

id.title: TAHAP 05 // KOMIT MARKDOWN GRAPH MEMORY
id.desc: Menyimpan pengetahuan relasional agent ke node graph Markdown yang mudah dibaca manusia dan bisa di-diff via Git—menghilangkan drift vektor kotak hitam.
